Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>When changing clans (Clan Impersonation, Qadir ul-Ghani, etc.) to Blood
>Brothers, is it possible to choose a circle as well as the clan ?

Most likely no.

"A vampire without a circle designation is assumed to be the only member of his
circle - a circle of one. As such, most Sanguinus cards will have little
benefit to him."

Halcyan 2
